description: This source file implements the prach_generator_impl class, which generates PRACH (Physical Random Access Channel) sequences for 3GPP LTE/NR systems, including methods for long and short preamble sequence generation, sequence number calculation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: prach_generator_impl
classes.description: Class responsible for generating PRACH sequences based on LTE/NR specifications, supporting both long and short preambles, with sequence number and cyclic shift calculations.

methods.name: get_sequence_number_long
methods.description: Calculates the long sequence number based on the root sequence index using a lookup table.

methods.name: get_sequence_number_short
methods.description: Calculates the short sequence number based on the root sequence index using a lookup table.

methods.name: generate_y_u_v_long
methods.description: Generates a long PRACH sequence (Y, U, V components) for a given sequence number and cyclic shift.

methods.name: generate_y_u_v_short
methods.description: Generates a short PRACH sequence (Y, U, V components) for a given sequence number and cyclic shift.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Main method to generate PRACH sequences based on configuration, handling both long and short preambles.
